thread.title: Rosenblatt Securities Analysts Give Apple (AAPL) a $200.00 Price Target

author: Hanz Christensen
title: Rosenblatt Securities Analysts Give Apple (AAPL) a $200.00 Price Target
text:
Tweet
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) received a $200.00 target price from equities research analysts at Rosenblatt Securities in a research note issued to investors on Monday. The firm presently has a “buy” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. Rosenblatt Securities’ price objective suggests a potential downside of 10.21% from the company’s previous close.
Several other research analysts have also weighed in on AAPL. Sanford C. Bernstein restated a “neutral” rating and set a $190.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, June 25th. Barclays upped their target price on shares of Apple from $161.00 to $175.00 and gave the stock an “equal weight” rating in a research report on Tuesday, June 26th. Loop Capital upped their target price on shares of Apple from $195.00 to $210.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Friday, July 6th. Royal Bank of Canada restated a “buy” rating and set a $210.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, July 9th. Finally, Bank of America reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $230.00 price target (up previously from $225.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, July 10th. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have assigned a hold rating and thirty have given a buy rating to the stock. The company presently has an average rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $224.63. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of AAPL opened at $222.73 on Monday. The company has a current ratio of 1.31, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84. Apple has a twelve month low of $150.24 and a twelve month high of $233.47. The stock has a market cap of $1,077.94 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 24.18, a P/E/G ratio of 1.68 and a beta of 1.36. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a net margin of 21.98% and a return on equity of 43.50%. The company had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $52.43 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the business posted $1.67 earnings per share. The firm’s revenue for the quarter was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. Equities analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.76 EPS for the current year.
In related news, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, August 27th. The shares were sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total transaction of $57,749,196.40. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is accessible through this hyperlink . Also, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 25,000 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Wednesday, October 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $232.66, for a total transaction of $5,816,500.00. Following the transaction, the senior vice president now directly owns 105,538 shares in the company, valued at approximately $24,554,471.08. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold 564,185 shares of company stock worth $124,444,213 in the last three months. Insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
A number of large investors have recently bought and sold shares of the business. River Wealth Advisors LLC increased its position in shares of Apple by 1.4% in the first quarter. River Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 40,153 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $6,737,000 after acquiring an additional 563 shares in the last quarter. Inverness Counsel LLC NY increased its position in shares of Apple by 29.3% in the first quarter. Inverness Counsel LLC NY now owns 217,412 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $36,477,000 after acquiring an additional 49,273 shares in the last quarter. Dean Capital Investments Management LLC acquired a new stake in shares of Apple in the first quarter worth $1,025,000. West Branch Capital LLC acquired a new stake in shares of Apple in the first quarter worth $5,939,000. Finally, Mirador Capital Partners LP increased its position in shares of Apple by 34.6% in the first quarter. Mirador Capital Partners LP now owns 36,703 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $6,066,000 after acquiring an additional 9,438 shares in the last quarter. 58.51% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
